messages:
sam (partners): heads-up: planning a BridgeKit onramp bundle that bundles LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters, a Redwood gateway connector, and HW acceleration profiles into one marketplace SKU. need to decide: closed beta length, embargo timing, demo kit owner, and packaging/pricing. quick takes?

ivy: recommend a 10-14 day closed beta with 3 tooling partners (mix of ISV+SI). embargo 48h before listing. create a small trust badge 'Redwood BridgeKit Ready' for verified adapters.

tomas: demo kit should be minimal: a tiny chat UI, index ingestion example (LlamaIndex), an agent flow (LangChain), dockerized sample, and CI smoke script. i'll own the CI smoke. want the smoke script to exercise generation + embeddings.

rukmini: HW profiles: include h100-small, a100-legacy, and t4-compat. gating rule: adapter passes smoke on >=2 SKUs to get the badge. i'll add hw profiles to helm values and a CI matrix.

ops-bot: ci/smoke-bridgekit #210 PASSED (2026-03-06T11:04Z)

sam (partners): proposed timeline:
- Mar 6: seed beta invites sent
- Mar 20: beta end, collect feedback
- Mar 22: partner embargo lifts 00:00 PT
- Mar 24: public listing + co-announcement (blog + joint PR assets)

sam (partners): packaging suggestion: two SKUs - 'BridgeKit Starter' (hosted payg) and 'BridgeKit Enterprise' (reserved + support). include billing fields product_id, sku, tier, partner_id. sara/legal to confirm revenue share wording.

ivy: will draft partner invite + NDA checklist. also will prepare a lightweight eval set to catch hallucination spikes.

tomas: demo repo + README by EOD Fri. adding smoke run and test-matrix CSV.

rukmini: opening PR for hw profiles and CI matrix today.

sam (partners): action owners:
- partner invites & NDA: ivy 9Mar 7
- demo repo + README: tomas 9Mar 6
- hw profiles + CI: rukmini 9Mar 6 PR
- SKU + pricing draft: sam 9Mar 12

sam (partners): any objections? otherwise i'll send invites and the beta roster after lunch. :rocket:
